source_transcripts.text: I got burned by a forecast miss in front of the board. Honestly I was worried reps wouldn't actually use another tool.
We missed the number and I had to explain it to the board - that's what got me looking.
After the Q2 miss the board lost confidence in my forecast. Also, would reps use it? They ignore most tools.
A new CRO wanted to standardize tooling, so we ran an evaluation.
The forecast miss in front of our board was the trigger. My main fear was adoption - reps hate new tools.
Board meeting went badly after a big deal slipped. I was worried reps wouldn't use another tool.
Our new CRO wanted one standard stack across regions.
I got embarrassed by a forecast miss in the board deck. Reps adopting it was my biggest worry.
Forecast miss, board was unhappy, I needed visibility. And reps wouldn't use yet another tool, I thought.
We were just growing fast and wanted better process.
